meta.name: campaign-architect
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "plan my paid account structure", "pick Search vs PMax", "lay out ad groups / asset groups", or "audit paid-vs-organic cannibalization"; designs campaign-type selection, ad-group/asset-group layout, targeting + match types, negative/exclusion hygiene, and a paid↔organic overlap audit, and scores the ROAS A (Audience) dimension + structure. Not for computing the final RQS — use ad-account-auditor; not for budget split — use budget-optimizer; not for organic site architecture — use site-structure-optimizer. 付费广告账户结构/广告系列规划/否定关键词

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划付费广告账户结构，优化广告系列与关键词布局
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在管理付费搜索广告账户，需要规划或审计广告系列结构。
copy.tagline_en: Plan paid ad account structure, optimize campaign and keyword layout
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid search ad accounts and need to plan or audit campaign structure.

howto.what: 帮你规划付费广告账户的结构，包括选择广告系列类型（搜索/PMax/广泛匹配）、设计广告组或资产组布局、设置定向和匹配类型、整理否定关键词和排除列表，并检查付费与自然搜索是否重叠。
howto.when: 当你需要设计或重构付费广告账户结构时，例如选择广告系列类型、分组广告组、设置定向和否定关键词，或检查付费与自然搜索的冲突。

say.text: 帮我规划付费广告账户结构，目标是提升转化率，平台是Google Ads。
say.note: 技能会输出广告系列类型、广告组布局和否定关键词列表。

say.text: 检查付费和自然搜索是否在竞争相同关键词。
say.note: 技能会分析重叠并给出建议。

say.text: 为我的电商账户设计PMax资产组布局。
say.note: 技能会按受众/商品细分分组。

howto.what_en: Plans the structure of a paid-ads account: selects campaign types (Search/PMax/broad), lays out ad groups or asset groups, sets targeting and match types, builds negative-keyword and exclusion lists, and audits paid-vs-organic overlap.
howto.when_en: When designing or restructuring a paid-ads account before launch: choosing campaign types, grouping ad groups, setting targeting and match types, building negative/exclusion lists, or checking paid-organic cannibalization.

say_en.text: Plan my paid account structure for conversion growth on Google Ads.
say_en.note: Outputs campaign types, ad group layout, and negative keywords.

say_en.text: Audit paid vs organic cannibalization for my keywords.
Design PMax asset group layout for my ecommerce account.
